name: temple_of_af_klint
promptTemplate: A monumental sacred diagram evoking Hilma af Klint, configured with {{palette_mode}} pigments, {{geometry}} forms, a {{breathing_rate}} breath cycle, {{symmetry}} petal symmetry, with mystic halo {{mystic_halo}} and geometric diagrams {{diagram_lines}}.

ui.title: Temple of af Klint
ui.tagline: Sacred botanical diagrams breathing in pastel tempera

palette_mode.hint: Shifts between tempera palettes drawn from Hilma's works

geometry.hint: Morphs between layered petals, spirals, and concentric eggs

breathing_rate.hint: Sets the cadence of the slow central pulse

symmetry.hint: Sets the petal count and diagram ticks

mystic_halo.hint: Soft radial luminescence around the mandala

diagram_lines.hint: Dashed compass circles and celestial axis markings

listing.blurb: Monumental sacred geometry evokes Hilma af Klint with breathing pastel tempera petals, spirals, and radiating halos steered by the room.
listing.prompt: In the spirit of Hilma af Klint's large paintings: soft pastel spirals, petals, nested circles and symmetrical botanical forms slowly bloom and rotate on a muted ground, as if a painting were breathing. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
